title: Owner Auto Policy Rate and Rule Manual — Liability and Uninsured Motorist Limits by Package
content:
**Owner Auto Policy — liability limits schedule.** Each of the six Cardinal Point liability packages written on the Owner Auto Policy carries the bodily injury and property damage liability limits below. Amounts are in USD.

| Package | Bodily injury per person | Bodily injury per accident | Property damage per accident |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability | garaging state's minimum | garaging state's minimum | garaging state's minimum |
| Cardinal Point 50/100/50 Liability | 50000 | 100000 | 50000 |
| Cardinal Point 100/200/50 Liability | 100000 | 200000 | 50000 |
| Cardinal Point 100/300/50 Liability | 100000 | 300000 | 50000 |
| Cardinal Point 100/300/100 Liability | 100000 | 300000 | 100000 |
| Cardinal Point 250/500/100 Liability | 250000 | 500000 | 100000 |

Where a limit reads "garaging state's minimum", the figure is the garaging state's minimum financial responsibility limit from the state table below.

### State minimum financial responsibility limits (all packages)

| Garaging state | Bodily injury per person | Bodily injury per accident | Property damage per accident | Bodily injury required without an SR-22 or FR-44 filing |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Florida | 10000 | 20000 | 10000 | No (Florida requires bodily injury only for filers) |
| Virginia | 50000 | 100000 | 25000 | Yes |
| Texas | 30000 | 60000 | 25000 | Yes |
| Georgia | 25000 | 50000 | 25000 | Yes |
| Arizona | 25000 | 50000 | 15000 | Yes |
| Ohio | 25000 | 50000 | 25000 | Yes |

### FR-44 financial responsibility limits (all packages)

A policy that supports an FR-44 certificate must carry at least these limits in the state named:

| State | Bodily injury per person | Bodily injury per accident | Property damage per accident |
|---|---|---|---|
| Florida | 100000 | 300000 | 50000 |
| Virginia (twice the Virginia minimum) | 100000 | 200000 | 50000 |

### Uninsured/underinsured motorist bodily injury (all packages)

The uninsured/underinsured motorist bodily injury limit equals the package's bodily injury limits, unless lower limits or rejection were elected in writing where the state permits. The named insured may reject uninsured/underinsured motorist bodily injury in writing in Florida, Texas, Georgia, Arizona and Ohio. Virginia requires the coverage, so rejection is not available there.

**Reading the schedule (hypothetical).** A Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability term garaged in Texas carries 30000 per person, 60000 per accident and 25000 property damage. The same package garaged in Arizona carries 25000, 50000 and 15000.
